description: Cut-away liquid parcel: outer steel-grey metal / strong wood box, glass bottle with tight cap inside, sand-coloured sawdust/bran filling the gap all round. 520x460. Parts #outer-box #absorbent #bottle #cap #liquid.

Strong wooden case with steel corner plates and a hasp, lid closed, for insured bullion and coins. 420x300.

Steel straight pin, grey shaft with round red head. 40x220.
